brief: Sava, a younger son of King Stephen I of Serbia, left home in his teens to become a monk on Mount Athos. There his father joined him a few years later. Together they founded the monastery of Chilandari, a centre of Serbian religion and culture, which continues to this day. About 1208, Sava returned to Serbia and helped consolidate the kingdom under his brother Stephen II. He also reformed and reorganised religious life. He established an autonomous Serbian church and became its first archbishop. Sava died in 1235. He is the patron saint of Serbia.
